notes: The spec doesn't define which writes are unsupported, so CHK-008 infers it. If the tracker saw zero APB write completions, the write is treated as unsupported and BRESP must be SLVERR (2'b10). If it saw one or more, the write is treated as supported and the APB count must equal AWLEN+1, with BRESP decided by the accumulated PSLVERR. The CHK-014 tracker isn't given, so I rebuilt a minimal write tracker from interface signals. It starts at the AW handshake and ends at the B handshake. It assumes AW comes before W. A W handshake in the same cycle as the AW handshake is counted. I haven't compiled this in Verilator.
